decisions.reason: Uses the release log order (build 16:22, bump 16:23) and the bundle's inlined 0.3.6 constant to explain the self-comparison against v0.3.7; states the constant is not read at runtime, mirror SHAs are irrelevant, and proposes bump-first plus a grep gate on the built artifact while keeping mirror verification.

Reads PNG 200 as proof the route handler lives and SVG 404 as the old whitelist in the running process while the on-disk link-installed lib already allows svg; requires a host restart because the route and its whitelist closure are registered at boot/apply time, and a browser refresh does not touch it.

Contrasts well-formed source, clean typed result and clean re-read with the spliced persisted model-visible text to place corruption in upstream result-text assembly; treats the payload as untrusted and says the good SVG must not be edited.

Orders disk-bytes asset route, then session payload only after DOMParser parsererror check, then a sandboxed iframe without allow-scripts fed validated content where SMIL still runs, then an explicit error state, with justification for each level.

Describes decoding the concatenated zstd frames in order, locating the read-result entry, extracting the exact stored splice, diffing with the source and filing upstream; checklist covers bump-before-build, shipped-constant grep, per-mirror SHA checks and plane-specific post-restart probes.

caps.reason: Final advice consistently requires bump before build, rebuild rather than mirror repush, host restart, leaving the SVG untouched, validation before payload render and a script-blocking sandbox.
